answer:
Release 0.34.3 extended the `GET /api/show` endpoint to advertise each model's thinking controls and default settings. This information is available both through the CLI and via an API call, as described in the context from [1] ollama/v0.34.3.md (lines 1-41):

"GET /api/show now advertises each model's thinking controls and default:

Available in the CLI with:
```
ollama show gemma4
```

```
    thinking
        levels     false, true
        default    true
```

Available in the API with:
```sh 
curl http://localhost:11434/api/show -d '{"model": "glm-5.3-flash:cloud"}'
```"

["ollama/v0.34.3.md (lines 1-41)"][https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.34.3]
